mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE ) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE draft_status = 'EDITING') AS editing_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE btrim(online_version_id) <> '') AS online_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE draft_status IS NULL) AS invalid_state_count FROM scoped

, page AS ( SELECT * FROM scoped WHERE ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset} ) SELECT s.*, specialists.specialist_id, specialists.specialist_name FROM page s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT string_agg(nullif(btrim(), ''), ',' ORDER BY r.sort_no, r.id) AS specialist_id, string_agg(nullif(btrim(), ''), ',' ORDER BY r.sort_no, r.id) AS specialist_name FROM entity_relation r WHERE ) specialists ON TRUE ORDER BY s.update_time DESC, s.id DESC
